title: Vivos Therapeutics Secures New U.S. Patent Expanding Protection for Vivos CARE Technology
excerpt: The newly issued patent broadens intellectual property protection for Vivos’ flagship oral medical device platform, reinforcing its competitive position in t...
content_html:
Fiona Craig

Wed, August 5, 2026 at 10:48 AM EDT 2 min read

The newly issued patent broadens intellectual property protection for Vivos' flagship oral medical device platform, reinforcing its competitive position in the obstructive sleep apnea treatment market.

Key Investor Takeaways

  • Vivos Therapeutics (NASDAQ:VVOS) received a new U.S. patent that expands intellectual property protection for its Vivos CARE oral medical device technology.

  • The new patent complements an earlier patent, creating broader protection that the company says is more difficult for competitors to design around.

  • The strengthened patent portfolio supports Vivos' FDA-cleared Vivos CARE devices for treating severe obstructive sleep apnea in adults and moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea in children.

  • Management believes the expanded patent coverage reinforces the company's competitive positioning as it commercializes its sleep apnea technologies.

  • The announcement focuses on intellectual property expansion rather than new financial results or commercial agreements.

Why VVOS Stock Is in Focus

Vivos Therapeutics (NASDAQ:VVOS) announced that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office has issued U.S. Patent No. 12,697,190, covering aspects of its Vivos CARE oral medical device technology used to treat obstructive sleep apnea (OSA).

The newly issued patent is a continuation of U.S. Patent No. 12,048,608, granted in 2024. According to the company, the two patents provide layered protection, with the earlier patent covering specific structural designs while the new patent broadens protection around the underlying technology. Vivos believes this combination creates stronger intellectual property barriers for competing products.

The company noted that its Vivos CARE devices previously received two FDA 510(k) clearances covering severe OSA in adults and moderate-to-severe OSA in children between the ages of six and 17. Vivos stated these remain the only oral appliances to receive those specific FDA clearances.

Chief Executive Officer Kirk Huntsman said the expanded patent portfolio reflects the company's continued investment in protecting its technology and strengthening its competitive position.

Why This Matters for Investors

While the announcement does not include new financial or operating results, intellectual property protection can be an important strategic asset for medical device companies.

Broader patent coverage may strengthen Vivos' ability to defend its technology, support product differentiation, and potentially reduce the risk of competing products using similar designs. For investors, this could reinforce the company's long-term commercialization strategy around its flagship Vivos CARE platform.

新颁发的专利扩大了 Vivos 旗舰口腔医疗设备平台的知识产权保护，增强了其在阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停治疗市场的竞争地位。

主要投资者要点

  • Vivos Therapeutics（纳斯达克股票代码：VVOS）获得了一项新的美国专利，扩大了其 Vivos CARE 口腔医疗设备技术的知识产权保护。
  • 这项新专利补充了一项早期专利，创造了更广泛的保护，该公司表示，竞争对手更难围绕这一点进行设计。
  • 强化的专利组合支持 Vivos 经 FDA 批准的 Vivos CARE 设备，用于治疗成人严重阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停和儿童中重度阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停。
  • 管理层认为，随着公司将睡眠呼吸暂停技术商业化，扩大的专利覆盖范围将增强公司的竞争地位。
  • 该公告的重点是知识产权扩张，而不是新的财务业绩或商业协议。

为什么 VVOS 股票成为焦点

Vivos Therapeutics（纳斯达克股票代码：VVOS）宣布，美国专利商标局已授予美国专利号 12,697,190，涵盖其用于治疗阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停 (OSA) 的 Vivos CARE 口腔医疗设备技术的各个方面。

这项新颁发的专利是 2024 年授予的美国专利号 12,048,608 的延续。 该公司表示，这两项专利提供了分层保护，早期专利涵盖了特定的结构设计，而新专利则扩大了对基础技术的保护。 Vivos 认为，这种组合为竞争产品创造了更强大的知识产权壁垒。

该公司指出，其 Vivos CARE 设备此前已获得两项 FDA 510(k) 许可，涵盖成人严重 OSA 和 6 至 17 岁儿童中度至重度 OSA。 Vivos 表示，这些仍然是唯一获得 FDA 特定许可的口腔矫治器。

首席执行官柯克·亨斯曼 (Kirk Huntsman) 表示，扩大的专利组合反映了公司在保护其技术和加强竞争地位方面的持续投资。

为什么这对投资者很重要

虽然该公告未包括新的财务或运营业绩，但知识产权保护可能是医疗器械公司的重要战略资产。

更广泛的专利覆盖范围可能会增强 Vivos 捍卫其技术、支持产品差异化的能力，并可能降低竞争产品使用类似设计的风险。 对于投资者而言，这可能会加强该公司围绕其旗舰 Vivos CARE 平台的长期商业化战略。
